hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path;if(f)process.stdout.write(f)}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; case "$f" in frontend/*) (cd frontend && npx --no-install prettier --write "${f#frontend/}") ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
